tobias-seidel--duisburg-essen.notes: Professor of economics at Mercator School of Management, UDE (search summaries of STEG, VoxDev and the chair group page). Identity rests on a search summary of ResearchGate, not a fetched page; the Google Sites contact page was not fetched. Also chairs DFG graduate program 'Regional Disparities and Economic Policy'.
